standard.summary: 正则化数据集路径。默认留空，不使用正则化图像。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The path to the regularisation dataset. Blank by default, meaning no regularisation images are used.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 正则化数据集路径。默认留空，不使用正则化图像。适用于全量训练，轻量 LoRA 可忽略

advanced_en.principle: Regularization dataset path. Leave empty by default to not use regularization images. Relevant for full fine-tuning; lightweight LoRA can ignore it.
